mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies near Verona Area High School and a Waning Gibbous moon overhead, with an overnight low of 64 degrees and rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona Water Utility is beginning cross connection control surveys, and residents should keep an eye on the mail for a letter regarding their appointment; meanwhile, the city is also reminding voters that early in-person absentee voting begins soon at City Hall.
Today is packed with activities including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and trivia at The Bogey Factory, while tomorrow offers an Art Bar Happy Hour at ART House 360 and Hop Haus trivia.
On September 21, officers investigated a retail theft where a subject was identified stealing candy from a business in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue.
The Culver's flavor of the day, Double Strawberry, has come to an end for the evening, but you can look forward to the return of Chocolate Heath Crunch when the doors open tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
